content: Section 14 of the Standards of Care in Diabetes—2024 focuses on the management and care of children and adolescents with diabetes. It provides detailed, evidence-based recommendations for the diagnosis, treatment, and ongoing monitoring of diabetes in this population. The section emphasizes the importance of individualized care plans that address the unique physiological, psychological, and developmental needs of children and adolescents. It also highlights the role of family involvement, education, and support in achieving optimal glycemic control and preventing complications.
